|notes=The [[Gold Leader In Gold 1 (V) (Virtual Set 10: Fourth Anthology) (Original 2005)|2005 original wording]] survives in the recovered publisher sheet. Deploy rises from 2 to 3. The original allows a 1 Force payment to cancel a react at the same system. The remaster prevents the opponent from reacting to this card’s location. Dutch’s ability, passenger or pilot capacity, and the opponent’s battle destiny cost are carried forward.
